FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF MUSIC
Panjab University, Chandigarh
Ref.: 480/MUS/23 Date: 11.09.2023
APPLICATIONS ARE INVITED FOR THE APPOINTMENT OF GUEST FACULTY IN
THE DEPARTMENT OF MUSIC, PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH:-
Posts No. of Seats Honorarium
Guest Faculty (Music-
Instrumental)
1 Rs.1500/- per lecture
subject to maximum of
Rs.50000/- per month
The applicant shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they are in the
department as a guest faculty. The candidates who are already availing JRF
scholarships in the University are not entitled for the honorarium but they will be
issued experience certificate for the guest faculty.

Qualifications:-
Eligibility (A or B):
A.
i) Master’s Degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale
wherever grading system is followed) in Hindustani Music-Instrumental
(Sitar) or an equivalent degree from an Indian/foreign University.
ii) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared
the National Eligibility (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test
accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a
Ph.D. Degree in accordance with University Grants commission (Minimum
Standards with Procedure for Award of M.Phil/Ph.D. Degree) Regulations,
2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as case may be.
Provided further, candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to
July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing
Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institutions awarding the degree
and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of
NET/SLET/SET for recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professor or
equivalent positions in Universities/Colleges/Institutions subject to the
fulfilment of the following conditions:
a) Ph.D. degree has been awarded to the candidate in a regular mode;
b) Evaluation of the Ph.D. thesis by at least two external examiners;
c) Open Ph.D. viva voce of the candidate has been conducted;
d) Candidate has published two research papers from his/her Ph.D.
work, out of which, at least one is in a refereed journal;
e) The candidate has presented at least two research papers based on
his/her Ph.D. work in conferences/ seminar supported/funded/
sponsored by the UGC/AICTE/ICCSSR or any other similar agency.
NET/SLET/SET shall also not be required for such Masters Programmes in
disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar
test accredited by the UGC (like SLET/SET)
OR
B. A traditional or a professional artist with highly commendable professional
achievement in the subject concerned having a Bachelor’s degree, who has:
i) Studied under a noted/reputed traditional Masters(s)/Artists(s)
ii) ‘A’ grade artist of AIR/Doordarshan;
iii) Ability to explain, with logical reasoning the subject concerned; and adequate
knowledge to teach theory with illustrations in the discipline concerned.
The applicants are required to fill the application form attached
herewith and submit the application form duly filled in along with
the attested copies of the academic testimonials/certificates to the
Chairperson, Department of Music, Panjab University, Chandigarh, PIN 160015 in
hard copy format only latest by 22.09.2023 upto 04:00 P:M.
 IMPORTANT :
 Mention Mobile Number, Whatsapp Number, Email ID Properly on the form to convey
the Interview schedule and any other information time to time.
 Fill SUMMARY SHEET (Page 10 of 12) of the application form properly
 Kindly be in touch with Panjab University and following website for further updates.
https://music.puchd.ac.in/show-noticeboard.php?nbid=1

Dr. Neelam Paul
(Chairperson)
